_note: Every constant used in cost and traffic estimates, with its source. verified=true means the value was checked against the named document on 2026-09-26 (see verified_note). Assumptions are labeled source=assumption and always shown as a range.

mobilization_pct.source: MoDOT Engineering Policy Guide, Category 618 Mobilization
mobilization_pct.verified_note: Page gives 4-5% surfacing, 5-6% grading, 7-8% bridges, up to 10% miscellaneous
mobilization_pct.note: DOT benchmark used as a proxy; transmission-specific values are not public

shareable_fraction.note: Share of one mobilization avoided by sharing crew move-in and staging

truck_cost_per_mile.source: ATRI, An Analysis of the Operational Costs of Trucking, 2025 data (published July 2026)
truck_cost_per_mile.verified_note: Industry-average cost to operate a truck in 2025: $2.336 per mile

lineworker_wage_per_hour.source: BLS OEWS, Electrical Power-Line Installers and Repairers (49-9051), state mean hourly wage

equipment_rate_per_hour.source: USACE EP 1110-1-8, Construction Equipment Ownership and Operating Expense Schedule, Region III (Southeast)
equipment_rate_per_hour.note: Rates are listed per make and model; not pinned to a generic bucket truck. The cost sandbox keeps its default truck rate.

row_width_ft.source: MISO Transmission Cost Estimation Guide for MTEP24, Table 3.1-1

line_cost_per_mile.source: MISO Transmission Cost Estimation Guide for MTEP24, Table 4.1-1 (new single circuit, Mississippi row; includes 30% contingency and 7.5% AFUDC)
line_cost_per_mile.note: MISO has no Georgia row; Mississippi is the nearest Southeast state in the table. New-line costs likely overstate rebuilds and reconductors. Used only to estimate redacted Georgia Power budgets, always labeled as an estimate.

land_value_per_acre.source: USDA NASS Land Values 2026 Summary (July 2026), farm real estate average value per acre
land_value_per_acre.verified_note: Farm real estate 2026: Georgia 4,950, South Carolina 4,900 (the 3,950 in the spec draft is not in the table)

value_of_travel_time.source: USDOT Benefit-Cost Analysis Guidance, 2026 update (federal values as restated in Caltrans Cal-B/C federal comparison, 2026)
value_of_travel_time.verified_note: Auto & truck composite all-purpose value $29.15 per vehicle-hour (2024$); applied per vehicle, so occupancy is 1.0

work_zone_capacity_per_lane.source: MoDOT EPG 616.13 Work Zone Capacity, Queue and Travel Delay (base work zone capacity 1600 pc/h/ln)

flagging_capacity_total.note: Alternating one-lane traffic under flagging, both directions combined

normal_capacity_per_lane.note: Free-flow capacity used to drain queues after a closure

directional_split.note: Share of daily traffic in the peak direction

hourly_profile.note: Typical weekday profile (share of daily traffic per hour, sums to 1.0)

fallback_aadt.note: Used when no count station matches the road

haul_loads_per_project.note: Heavy equipment loads to mobilize one line project

base_to_site_miles.note: Distance from contractor base to site when no base is known

route_factor.note: Road miles are about 1.2 x straight-line miles

flagger_crew.note: Flaggers per traffic-control setup; cost uses the BLS lineworker wage as a proxy
